hook.text: Take a cold shower for thirty seconds. Your nervous system will thank you all day.

water droplets cold splash slow motion

tips.text: First, cold water activates your vagus nerve. This drops your stress levels in seconds. You feel calmer for hours after.

calm peaceful face after shower closeup

tips.text: Second, it boosts your dopamine by 250 percent. That's a natural mood lift without coffee or sugar. You feel sharp and focused all morning.
queries: happy energized look after cold shower
fresh face splash water morning routine

tips.text: Third, it strengthens your immune system. Cold exposure trains your body to handle stress. People who do this get sick less often.

cta.text: Start with just thirty seconds tomorrow. Build up over time. Follow for more energy hacks that work.
